facts.fact: ARPCE's Pointe-Noire data centre, described as Tier 3+ with 54 racks, was put into service on 28 February 2024, and ARPCE's director general says it can host public administration and private sector data.

COG.note: The director general calls the data centre a tool of digital sovereignty and says it will be able to host public administration data, but no rule, goal document or hosting in place is stated.

facts.fact: Meta's 2Africa submarine cable, landed on the Congolese coast in August 2023, was officially connected by President Sassou N'Guesso at Pointe-Noire on 28 February 2024.

ARPCE, the state postal and electronic communications regulator, put its Tier 3+ Pointe-Noire data centre into service on 28 February 2024, stated as open to public administration and private sector data.
The Pointe-Noire Tier 3+ data centre is ARPCE's, the Congolese state regulator, housed in its departmental branch building.

COG.note: A continuity plan is mentioned in general terms, but no backup site for a public body's systems, in a named place and in service, is stated.
